items.text: The gig economy in India is not one labour market, it is at least two very different ones sharing the same label.

blocks.heading: Register on the Udyam Portal and Track

items.text: Register on the Udyam portal and track GST once income becomes regular.

supporting: Register on the Udyam portal and track GST once income becomes regular. As gig or freelance income scales into something closer to a small business, Udyam registration is free, quick, and can unlock collateral-free credit and delayed-payment protection under the MSMED Act. GST registration becomes compulsory once annual turnover crosses roughly ₹20 lakh (roughly ₹10 lakh in a few special-category states), confirm the current thresholds on gst.gov.in and the Udyam portal rather than assuming either number stays fixed.

visuals.heading: Actually Counts As Gig Work in India

blocks.sourceSectionTitle: What actually counts as gig work in India

rows: Platform-based mobility and delivery gig work
Food delivery, ride-hailing, hyperlocal quick-commerce delivery, courier and logistics gigs.
Very low entry barrier: a vehicle or bicycle, a smartphone, and a background check are usually enough to start earning within days.
Local task and services gig work
Home repair, cleaning, salon-at-home, moving help, appliance repair booked through an app.
Low to moderate barrier: usually needs a specific trade skill plus a platform profile, but little formal certification.

blocks.heading: Social Security Actually Changes for Gig Workers
blocks.sourceSectionTitle: What the Code on Social Security actually changes for gig workers
rows: Rather Than Through an Aggregator App
Rather Than Through an Aggregator App

The Code on Social Security, 2020 formally defines "gig worker" and "platform worker" as distinct categories outside the traditional employer-employee relationship, and brings both under a national social security framework for the first time.

Government-notified welfare schemes for gig and platform workers, which can include accident insurance, health and maternity benefits, and other social security benefits, depending on the scheme design in each state.

blocks.heading: Pay Is Usually Per Task, Per Delivery

items.text: Income ceiling is tied closely to hours worked and platform algorithm, with limited room to raise your own price.
Entry is fast: most people can start earning within days of signing up.
Career growth mostly means working more hours or shifting into platform operations, not a skill ladder within the gig itself.
